name: Leonardo.Ai
tagline: AI image and asset generation platform
description: Leonardo.Ai is an AI image generation platform.
limitations: The billing interval behind the listed monthly prices was unclear on the page

free.details: Free: 150 fast tokens per day, Auto model only, public creations, 1 personal collection.

plans.name: Premium
highlights: Unlimited relaxed image generation for select models

plans.name: Ultimate
highlights: Unlimited relaxed image and video generation for select models

plans.name: Team Starter
plans.billing: $72 per month for the team, shown as $24 per seat

plans.name: Team Growth
plans.billing: $144 per month for the team, shown as $48 per seat
highlights: Train AI models using team tokens

plans.name: API: Pay as you go
plans.note: No commitments, pay only for what you use; API credit does not expire; up to 10 concurrent generations

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD, labelled 'ex. tax'. The page has a 'Pay Yearly (up to 20% off)' and a 'Pay Monthly' toggle, but the figures did not change when we selected monthly, so we cannot say which billing interval the figures belong to. Treat them as indicative and check the page.
notes: Unlimited relaxed generation applies only to selected models and may be slowed during high demand (footnote on the page).

verification.notes: Product active. Solo plans in USD, ex. tax: Free $0 (150 fast tokens/day), Essential $12, Premium $30, Ultimate $60 per month; Team Starter $72/month ($24 per seat). Fast tokens per month: Essential 8,500, Premium 25,000, Ultimate 60,000. The Pay Yearly / Pay Monthly toggle (up to 20% off) still does not change the displayed figures, so the billing period is unconfirmed.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: A creator-first platform for making and editing images and video with AI

capabilities.title: Create images from prompts or custom models
capabilities.text: Generate high-quality visuals from simple prompts or from models tailored to your own aesthetic.

capabilities.title: Bring visuals into motion
capabilities.text: Turn static ideas into video with animation and motion tools for storytelling, social and product use.

capabilities.title: Edit without starting over
capabilities.text: Edit images and video while keeping characters, composition, style and intent intact.

capabilities.title: Raise quality at any size
capabilities.text: Boost resolution and clarity so assets are ready for print and high-resolution displays.

featureCards.name: Image generation
featureCards.text: Visuals from prompts, built to scale across concepts and styles.

featureCards.name: Custom models
featureCards.text: Create images tailored to your own look.

featureCards.name: Video and motion tools
featureCards.text: Animation aimed at storytelling, social and product experiences.

featureCards.name: Precision editing
featureCards.text: Refine and adjust a result instead of regenerating it.

featureCards.name: Upscaling
featureCards.text: Higher resolution and clarity without losing detail.

featureCards.name: Developer API
featureCards.text: A separate route for building the platform into your own product.

audienceDetail.text: The site's artist stories feature people from both groups.
A filmmaker is among the featured creators, and the video tools target storytelling.
Social and product content is named as a use for the motion tools.
The Developer API link is at the top of the page.

scenarios.title: Explore a visual concept
scenarios.text: Try several styles from simple prompts.

scenarios.title: Animate a still
scenarios.text: Turn an image into a short moving clip.

scenarios.title: Fix a detail without losing the rest
scenarios.text: Edit one element and keep the characters and composition.

scenarios.title: Prepare a print-ready asset
scenarios.text: Upscale an image before sending it to print.

gettingStarted.text: The button sits next to each of the four main capabilities.
Create images, bring visuals into motion, edit, or upscale.
A Developer API link is in the header.
